40006292.author: पदार्थः
40006292.content: महायशः renowned, प्रभुः lord, भरतः Bharata, स्निग्धगम्भीरघोषेण with its deep, soothing sound, स्यन्दनेन by the chariot, उपयान् while travelling, क्षिप्रम् soon, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, प्रविवेश entered.

40006292.author: Translation
40006292.content: Bharata, the renowned lord (of Ayodhya) travelled on the chariot that produced a deep, soothing, sound. And entered Ayodhya soon.

40006293.author: पदार्थः
40006293.content: बिडालोलूकचरिताम् ranged by cats and owls, आलीननरवारणाम् where people and elephants were out of sight, तिमीराभ्याहताम् enveloped in darkness, अप्रकाशाम् without light, कालीम्  black, निशामिव like night.

40006293.author: Translation
40006293.content: Ayodhya was like a dark, lightless night enveloped in gloom, ranged by cats and owls, its people and elephants out of sight.

40006294.author: पदार्थः
40006294.content: श्रिया with majesty, प्रज्वलितप्रभाम् radiating with lustre, अभ्युत्थितेन exalted, ग्रहेन by cruel planet, पीडिताम् tormented, राहुशत्रोः enemy of Rahu, (the Moon's), प्रियाम् beloved, पत्नीम् to wife, एकाम् alone, रोहिणीमिव like the star Rohini.

40006294.author: Translation
40006294.content: (The city looked) like Rohini, the beloved consort of the Moon, the star which was majesticlly radiating flaming brilliance and now, tormented by the exalted Rahu which has eclipsed the Moon, shines alone.

40006295.author: पदार्थः
40006295.content: अल्पोष्णक्षुब्धसलिलां with scant, hot and turbid waters, घर्मोत्तप्तविहङ्गमाम् the aquatic birds scorched by the Sun's heat, लीनमीनझषग्राहाम् small fish, large fish and crocodiles perished, कृशाम् dried up, गिरिनदीमिव like a mountainstream.

40006295.author: Translation
40006295.content: (It appeared) like a lean mountainstream with scant, hot and turbid waters, with scorched aquatic birds and with small and large fishes and crocodiles dead due to the heat of the Sun.

40006296.author: पदार्थः
40006296.content: विधूमाम् smokeless, हेमाभाम् with the splendour of gold, समुत्थिताम् rising, पश्चात् later on, हविरभ्युक्षिताम् sprinkled with sacrificial offering of clarified butter, विप्रलयम् extinction, गताम्  obtained, अध्वराग्नेः sacrificial fire's, शिखामिव like flames.

40006296.author: Translation
40006296.content: It was like the flame of a sacrificial fire, smokeless and golden as it rises, that dies down after the oblation of clarified butter has been sprinkled.

40006297.author: पदार्थः
40006297.content: महाहवे in a great battle, विध्वस्तकवचाम् armours scattered, रुग्णगजवाजिरथध्वजाम् injured elephants, horses and shattered chariots and banners standards, हतप्रवीराम् with heroic warriors slain, आपन्नाम् in great distress, चमूमिव like the army.

40006297.author: Translation
40006297.content: warriors slain in the great battle (the city appeared desolate).

40006298.author: पदार्थः
40006298.content: सफेनाम् filled with foam, सस्वनाम् भूत्वा with roaring sounds, समुत्थिताम् risen, प्रशान्तमारुतोद्धूताम् swept by the gentle breeze, निस्स्वनाम् silent, सागरस्य ocean's, जलोर्मिमिव like a wave.

40006298.author: Translation
40006298.content: It was like an ocean wave that had risen foaming and roaring but, swept by a gentle breeze, had fallen silent.

40006299.author: पदार्थः
40006299.content: सर्वैः all, यज्ञायुधैः with sacrificial appliances, अभिरूपैः learned, याजकैः with priests, सुत्याकाले the time of extraction of Soma juice, विनिर्वृते has come to an end, त्यक्ताम् deserted, गतरवाम् sounds ceased, वेदिम् इव like an altar.

40006299.author: Translation
40006299.content: It was like a sacrificial altar deserted by all its appliances and learned priests, fallen silent once the time of the Soma extraction had ended.

40006300.author: पदार्थः
40006300.content: गोवृषेण by a bull, परित्यक्ताम् forsaken, उत्सुकाम् longing (for the bull), गवाम् of cows, गोष्ठमध्ये in the midst of the herd, स्थिताम् standing, आर्ताम् despaired, नवं new, तृणम् grass, अचरन्तीं no longer grazing, पक्तिमिव like a cow.

40006300.author: Translation
40006300.content: the midst of the herd despairs and no longer grazes the new grass.

40006301.author: पदार्थः
40006301.content: सुस्निग्धै: by the most glossy, प्रज्वलद्भिरिव by the radiant, उत्तमैः by the excellent ones, जात्यैः by those of the finest class, प्रभाकराद्यैः rubies and other gems, मणिभिः with precious stones, वियुक्ताम् detached, नवाम् new, मुक्तावलीमिव like a pearl necklace.

40006301.author: Translation
40006301.content: It was like a new pearl necklace from which the finest, glossy, radiant gems and rubies had been detached.

40006302.author: पदार्थः
40006302.content: पुण्यक्षयात् due to exhaustion of merit, स्थानात् from its place, सहसा suddenly, महीम् the earth, गताम् reached, संवृतद्युतिविस्ताराम् with its extensive lustre dimmed, दिवः from the earth, च्युताम् fallen, तारामिव like a star.

40006302.author: Translation
40006302.content: It was like a star, its spreading radiance dimmed, suddenly dislodged from its place and fallen from heaven to earth when its store of merit is exhausted.

40006303.author: पदार्थः
40006303.content: वसन्तान्ते at the end of spring, द्रुतदावाग्नि विप्लुष्टाम् ravaged by the fastspreading forest fire, पुष्पनद्धाम् laden with flowers, मत्तभ्रमरनादिताम् with the melodious hum of intoxicated bees, क्लान्ताम् withered away, वनलतामिव like a woodland creeper.

40006303.author: Translation
40006303.content: with the melodious humming of intoxicated bees and suddenly shrivelling, ravaged by the fastspreading forest fire.

40006304.author: पदार्थः
40006304.content: सम्मूढनिगमाम् dazed merchants, स्तब्धाम् stilled, संक्षिप्तविपणापणाम् with markets and shops closed, अम्बुधरैः with clouds, वृताम् covered, प्रच्छन्नशशिनक्षत्राम् obscuring the moon and stars, द्यामिव like the sky.

40006304.author: Translation
40006304.content: Ayodhya with its markets and shops closed, and its merchants in a daze looked like the sky covered with clouds obscuring the Moon and stars.

40006305.author: पदार्थः
40006305.content: आकाशे lying in the open, क्षीणपानोत्तमैः with excellent wine exhausted, भग्नैः by the broken, शरावैः by pitchers, अभिसंवृताम् surrounded by, हताशौण्डाम् with drunkards dead, ध्वस्ताम् scattered, असंस्कृताम् uncleansed, पानभूमि इव like a drinking place.

40006305.author: Translation
40006305.content: (Ayodhya looked) like an uncleansed drinking place with broken pitchers emptied of excellent wine scattered around and with drunkards lying dead in the open.

40006306.author: पदार्थः
40006306.content: वृक्णभूमितलाम् surface riven, वृक्णपात्रैः with broken pots, समावृताम् scattered around, निम्नाम् like a dale, उपयुक्तोदकाम् water used up, भग्नाम् broken, निपतिताम् sunken, प्रपामिव like a well.

40006306.author: Translation
40006306.content: (Ayodhya appeared) like a ruined well, its foundations broken and sunken into the earth, its water used up, with broken pots scattered around, its riven surface forming a dale.

40006307.author: पदार्थः
40006307.content: विपुलाम् extensive, वितताम् stretched, युक्तपाशाम् attached with nooses, तरस्विनाम् of a powerful man, बाणैः with arrows, विनिष्कृत्ताम् severed, आयुधात् from the weapon, भूमौ on the ground, पतिताम् fallen, ज्यामिव like a bowstring.

40006307.author: Translation
40006307.content: It was like a powerful man's bowstring, broad and stretched taut with its loops, severed by arrows and fallen from the weapon to the ground.

40006308.author: पदार्थः
40006308.content: युद्धशौण्डेन by a warrior skilled in warfare, हयारोहेण by the rider of a horse, सहसा suddenly, वाहिताम् carried, प्रतिसैन्येन by the enemy army, निहताम् slain, पातिताम् fallen on the ground, वडवामिव like a mare.

40006308.author: Translation
40006308.content: It was like a mare suddenly ridden hard by a battle-skilled horseman and then struck down and felled by the enemy army.

40006309.author: पदार्थः
40006309.content: शुष्कतोयाम् water dried up, बहुभिः a lot of, महामत्सैः with large fishes, कूर्मैश्च with tortoises, वृताम् filled, प्रभिन्नतटविस्तीर्णाम् vast area around the bank split, हृतोत्पलाम् waterlilies withered, वापीमिव like a circular reservoir of water.

40006309.author: Translation
40006309.content: It was like a reservoir with its water dried up, filled with great fish and tortoises, its broad banks split and its lotuses withered.

40006310.author: पदार्थः
40006310.content: प्रतिषिद्धानुलेपनां with no oil massaged (on the body), शोकेन with grief, सन्तप्ताम् scorched, अभूषणाम् without ornaments, अप्रहृष्टस्य in dejection, पुरुषस्य man's, गात्रयष्टिमिव body like a stick (skeletal).

40006310.author: Translation
40006310.content: It was like the skeletal frame of a dejected man, scorched with grief, denied unguents and stripped of ornaments.

40006311.author: पदार्थः
40006311.content: प्रविगाढायाम् deep, पावृषि in the rainy season, अभ्रमण्डलम् orb of clouds, प्रविष्टस्य entered, भास्करस्य the Sun's, नीलजीमूतैः by black clouds, प्रच्छन्नाम् obscured, प्रभामिव like the radiance.

40006311.author: Translation
40006311.content: It was like the radiance of the sun obscured by black clouds when it has entered the mass of clouds in the depth of the rainy season.

40006312.author: पदार्थः
40006312.content: श्रीमान् illustrious, दशरथात्मजः son of Dasaratha, भरतस्तु Bharata, रथस्थस्सन् seated in the chariot, रथश्रेष्ठम् the most excellent of chariots, वाहयन्तम् driving, सारथिम् to the charioteer, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40006312.author: Translation
40006312.content: Illustrious Bharata, son of Dasaratha, seated in his chariot, addressed the charioteer as he drove the most excellent of chariots saying:

40006313.author: पदार्थः
40006313.content: अयोध्यायाम् In Ayodhya, अद्य now, यथापुरम् as in the past, गम्भीरः deep, मूर्छितः allpervasive, गीतवादित्रनिस्वनः songs and sounds of musical instruments, न निशम्यते are not heard, किं नु खलु what could be the reason?

40006313.author: Translation
40006313.content: How is it that in Ayodhya, the deep and allpervasive songs and sounds of musical instruments of the former days are not heard now?

40006314.author: पदार्थः
40006314.content: वारुणीमदगन्धश्च the intoxicating odour of spirituous liquor, माल्यगन्धश्च the fragrance of flower garlands, धूपितागरुगन्धश्च the fragrance of agaru or incense, समन्ततः everywhere, मूर्छितः pervading, न प्रवाति does not blow.

40006314.author: Translation
40006314.content: The breeze no longer carries the intoxicating odour of spirituous liquor, the pervading fragrance of flower garlands and agaru (incense).

40006315.author: पदार्थः
40006315.content: रामे Rama, विवासिते having been exiled, इदानीम् now, अस्यां पुर्याम् in this city, यानप्रवरघोषश्च clatter of excellent carriages, स्निग्धः pleasant, हयनिस्वनश्च neighing of horses, प्रमत्तगजनादश्च trumpeting of elephants in rut, महान् great, रथनिस्वनः च rattle of chariots, न श्रूयते are not heard.

40006315.author: Translation
40006315.content: After Rama's the exile the clatter of excellent carriages, the pleasing neighing of horses and trumpeting of elephants in rut and the rattle of chariots are no longer heard now.

40006316.author: पदार्थः
40006316.content: रामे Rama, गते having departed, तरुणाः the young men, संतप्ताः distressed, चन्दनागरुगन्धांश्च   incense of agaru and sandalwood paste, महार्हा: expensive, नवस्रजश्च garlands of fresh flowers, नोपभुञ्जते do not enjoy.

40006316.author: Translation
40006316.content: Since Rama has departed, the young men in distress do not enjoy expensive incense of agaru and sandalwood paste and garlands of fresh flowers.

40006317.author: पदार्थः
40006317.content: रामे Rama, गते having departed, तरुणाः the young men, संतप्ताः distressed, चन्दनागरुगन्धांश्च   incense of agaru and sandalwood paste, महार्हा: expensive, नवस्रजश्च garlands of fresh flowers, नोपभुञ्जते do not enjoy.

40006317.author: Translation
40006317.content: Since Rama has departed, the young men in distress do not enjoy expensive incense of agaru and sandalwood paste and garlands of fresh flowers.

40006318.author: पदार्थः
40006318.content: रामशोकार्दिते stricken with grief on account of separation from Rama, पुरे in the city, नराः men, चित्रमाल्यधराः wearing garlands of variegated flowers, बहिः outside, यात्राम् pleasure jaunts, न गच्छन्ति do not go, उत्सवाः festivites, न सम्प्रवर्तन्ते are not celebrated.

40006318.author: Translation
40006318.content: This city is stricken with grief on account of Rama's departure. Men do not go out on pleasure jaunts wearing garlands of variegated flowers. Festivities are not celebrated.

40006319.author: पदार्थः
40006319.content: अस्य पुरस्य of this city, द्युतिः splendour, मम my, भ्रात्रा सह along with brother, गता had left, नूनम् certainly, इयम् this, अयोध्या Ayodhya, सासारा with rain pouring down, अर्जुनी relating to the waning Moon, क्षपा इव like night, न राजति हि does not gleam.

40006319.author: Translation
40006319.content: Certainly splendour has left along with my brother. Like the night when the rain pours down during the waning of the Moon, Ayodhya shines not.

40006320.author: पदार्थः
40006320.content: मे भ्राता my brother, महोत्सव इव like a carnival, आगतः having returned, ग्रीष्मे in summer, अम्बुदः इव like clouds, अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, हर्षम् delight, कदा when, जनयिष्यति नु खलु  will cause.

40006320.author: Translation
40006320.content: When will my brother return to Ayodhya like a carnival and cause delight to every one  like summer clouds?

40006321.author: पदार्थः
40006321.content: अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, महापथाः highways, चारुवेषैः by those elegantly attired, उन्नतगामिभिः with their majestic gait, सम्पतद्भिः by those coming together in groups, तरुणैः young men, नरैः men, नाभिभान्ति is not shining.

40006321.author: Translation
40006321.content: The highways of Ayodhya thronged with groups of elegantly attired young men or adults with their majestic gait, do not shine.

40006322.author: पदार्थः
40006322.content: एवम् thus, बहुविधम् in several ways, जल्पन् talking, तेन by that, नरेन्द्रेण by the king, हीनाम् bereft of, सिंहहीनाम् without a lion, गुहामिव like a cave, पितुः father's, वसतिम् residence,  विवेश entered.

40006322.author: Translation
40006322.content: Thus mourning in several ways, Bharata entered his fathers' palace (now) bereft of the king like a cave without the lion.
